$comment: Reviewed npm audit exceptions. Every entry needs id, package, scope, reason and expires (YYYY-MM-DD); the gate fails when one expires. Emptied 2026-11-15 after upgrading react-router 7, vite 8, vitest 4.

advisories.reason: Reviewed 2026-11-18. ReDoS on extglob patterns, affects every version up to 4.0.7 and no fixed release exists yet. Only the build and test tools use it (vite, vitest, vite-plugin-pwa); it is never shipped, and the patterns it reads are this repo's own config, not user input. Upgrade picomatch (via vite/vitest) once a fixed release lands.
